cases.module_name: 问答运营控制面（默认关闭）
cases.scenario: 多代相同ID隔离、从公开事实独立推导完整性、失败阻断及带备份的FTS定向修复。

expectations.statement: staging构建、单代更新/删除/清理不破坏另一代FTS和关键词命中。
公开资料漏收、同数量错配、FTS或向量错误/不可达不得通过审计、开放真实gate或切换代次。
修复保留备份与非目标代次，不嵌入或写向量，失败回滚、重复执行零变化。
完整索引通过本地或容量HTTP finalize并保持正确runtime和围栏，切换后逐条审计通过。

cases.scenario: M10.index: assistant_index scenarios at the existing module boundary.

expectations.statement: chunker is deterministic and strips html noise; outbox records lifecycle in the same transaction; profile and taxonomy name changes enqueue tasks; worker rebuild retriever and staleness; worker owner is singleton and fence advances after expiry; existing search and openapi are unchanged by assistant index

qdrant payload allowlist rejects document text; projector excludes drafts old revisions and hidden profile; retriever degrades without dense and is not ready without fts; embeddings are deterministic and worker fails closed
